channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Richard Hamilton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Richard Hamilton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Gilbert Arenas, Richard Hamilton
item.description:
When asked about the players who influenced his style, CJ McCollum rattled off a list of all-time greats.

“Besides my brother? I watched a lot of Allen Iverson. I watched a lot of Steve Nash. I watched a lot of Rip Hamilton. I watched young Gilbert [Arenas] and obviously Kobe and Mike,”

CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Gilbert Arenas, Richard Hamilton, Mar 23, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Ben Wallace on Rasheed Wallace, Richard Hamilton, Chauncey Billups, Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
“Smart enough to draft Tayshaun Prince, smart enough to trade for Rip Hamilton, smart enough to trade for Chauncey Billups, smart enough to trade for and believe in Rasheed (Wallace). So you know, it is what it is.”

Ben Wallace on Rasheed Wallace, Richard Hamilton, Chauncey Billups, Tayshaun Prince, May 7, 2020. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Richard Hamilton, Draymond Green
item.description:
Billups:

“All the time. So him and Jordan Dumars -- who was Joe's son -- best friends. They were around the team every day, all day. We raised Draymond. That's my son. We raised him. We're on a group chat all the time -- Draymond, myself, Ben (Wallace), Rip (Richard Hamilton), Sheed -- we on a group chat arguing whose teams are better ... that's our son!”

Chauncey Billups on Richard Hamilton, Draymond Green, Apr 12, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Richard Hamilton
item.description:
“I’m upset that I gave Richard Hamilton something to brag about. Up until that point, he never beat me. That just kills me.”

Kobe Bryant on Richard Hamilton, Dec 5, 2015. Source: Los Angeles Daily News.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Richard Hamilton
item.description:
Mike McGraw:Derrick Rose on addition of Rip Hamilton:

“With him, I’m going to have a lot more assists this year.”

Derrick Rose on Richard Hamilton, Dec 14, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Ben Gordon on Richard Hamilton
item.description:
With a youth movement potentially around the corner, Gordon and others have begun to wonder if they'll be the next to go.

“When you see stuff happening to a guy like Richard Hamilton, who has won a championship here and had so many great years, I'd be foolish to think that the same couldn't happen to me or anybody else in this room. That's what's going on right now with our team,”

Ben Gordon on Richard Hamilton, Jan 25, 2011. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Richard Hamilton
item.description:
Chris Iott:Joe Dumars on Richard Hamilton:

“Rip and I had a great conversation. He's the last guy that I need to worry about competing.”

Joe Dumars on Richard Hamilton, Dec 21, 2010. Source: Twitter.
